# Fraction — Senior technical leadership, fractionally
> Fraction (getfractioncto.com) is a fractional CTO service for early-stage founders.
> The founder works with seed- to Series-A companies on a flat monthly retainer,
> owning technical decisions, building engineering teams, and steering the build —
> without the $400k full-time salary or equity grant a full-time CTO requires.

Fraction is an independent practice, not an agency. Engagements are month-to-month,
no equity, cancellable anytime. The audience is non-technical founders, technical
founders who need a sparring partner, agencies that need senior judgment, and
investors doing technical due diligence on portfolio companies.

The site is content-rich: short, opinionated essays on technical judgment —
build vs. buy, technical due diligence, fractional vs. full-time CTO, hiring
senior engineers, agency invoice review, and knowing when to graduate to a
full-time CTO. Every essay opens with a direct claim and supports it with
specific patterns from real engagements (figures are illustrative).

## Service

- [How it works](https://getfractioncto.com/how-it-works): the engagement model
- [Pricing](https://getfractioncto.com/pricing): three retainer tiers (Advisory $6k/mo, Embedded $12k/mo, Command $18k/mo) plus a one-off $7,500 Tech Teardown
- [Comparison](https://getfractioncto.com/comparison): fractional CTO vs. full-time CTO vs. agency vs. tech advisor
- [The Tech Teardown](https://getfractioncto.com/teardown): a two-week written diagnostic of architecture, team, vendors, and roadmap
- [Book a fit call](https://getfractioncto.com/book-a-call): a free 20-minute call

- [Why I don't bill by the hour](https://getfractioncto.com/post-no-hourly): the case for a flat retainer over hourly billing
- [What investors actually ask about your architecture](https://getfractioncto.com/post-diligence): the six questions that come up in technical due diligence
- [You're not ready for a full-time CTO. Here's how to know.](https://getfractioncto.com/post-ready-for-cto): the honest test for when fractional becomes false economy
- [The agency invoice nobody reads](https://getfractioncto.com/post-agency-invoice): motion vs. progress, read line by line
- [Welcome to the new writing setup](https://getfractioncto.com/post-welcome): how this site is published
